page.layout: One manuscript leaf, not a printed page. Red five-line staves run vertically down the leaf, with square-notated chant (black neumes) on them. A large decorated initial stands at upper centre, and a red initial sits at the right edge. Black-letter syllables run vertically in several columns, mostly between and beside the staves. No running head, page number or catchwords are visible.
page.notes: Manuscript chant leaf (square notation on red staff lines), not printed text. The vertical black-letter syllables are too faint and fragmentary to read reliably, so they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The large initial at upper centre is a decorated capital, probably B, and the red initial at right is probably H; both are uncertain. The lower edge is damaged and partly cut off. The left and right edges show staff lines only, with no marginal text.
